skill.summary: create video clips or images into finished MP4 videos with this skill. Works with MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files up to 500MB. casual creators and beginners use it...

latestVersion.changelog:
Free Video Maker Easy 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Quickly assemble video clips or images into finished 1080p MP4 videos using cloud GPUs; typical processing 30–60 seconds.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, and PNG up to 500MB per file for easy uploads.
- Automatic setup: acquires a free token and creates a cloud session for seamless first use.
- Simple chat interface — upload your files and describe your requests for combining, exporting, or editing videos.
- Includes real-time status, export/download, and credit/balance check actions, all mapped to easy user prompts.
- Detailed error handling and “still working” progress updates included for a smooth experience.
